mapper.sql: B.BOOK_SN AS BOOK_ID, B.BOOK_MNG_NO AS BOOK_MANAGEMENT_NUMBER, B.BOOK_NM AS TITLE, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.BOOK_IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS IMAGE_URL, B.AUT_NM AS AUTHOR_NAME, B.PBLCO_NM AS PUBLISHER_NAME, B.PBLCN_YR AS PUBLICATION_YEAR, B.CLNO AS CALL_NUMBER, B.BOOK_PSTN_NM AS LOCATION_NAME, B.BOOK_CN AS DESCRIPTION, B.RCMDTN_YN AS RECOMMENDED_YN, B.RCMDTN_CLSF_CD AS RECOMMENDATION_CATEGORY_CODE, C.CD_DTL_NM AS RECOMMENDATION_CATEGORY_NAME, B.RCMDTN_SORT_SEQ AS RECOMMENDATION_SORT_SEQUENCE, B.NEW_BOOK_YR AS NEW_BOOK_YEAR, B.NEW_BOOK_MM AS NEW_BOOK_MONTH, B.REG_YMD AS REGISTERED_DATE, COALESCE(B.INQ_CNT, 0) AS VIEW_COUNT
FROM LIB_BOOK B LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = 'COM046' AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.RCMDTN_CLSF_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY
B.RCMDTN_SORT_SEQ DESC,
B.REG_YMD DESC, B.BOOK_SN DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT
WHERE B.BOOK_SN = #{value} AND B.DEL_DT IS NULL AND B.EXPSR_YN = 'Y'

SELECT FROM LIB_BOOK_REL R INNER JOIN LIB_BOOK B ON B.BOOK_SN = R.REL_BOOK_SN LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = 'COM046' AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.RCMDTN_CLSF_CD WHERE R.BOOK_SN = #{value} AND B.DEL_DT IS NULL AND B.EXPSR_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.REG_YMD DESC, B.BOOK_SN DESC
SELECT C.CD_DTL_ID AS CATEGORY_CODE, C.CD_DTL_NM AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM CMMN_CD_DTL C WHERE C.CD_ID = 'COM046' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC, C.CD_DTL_ID ASC
